dedupe_keys.name: synthetic dataset of emergency healthcare services simio generated patient flow records triage medical records outpatient department waiting times utilisation

description: This Zenodo dataset gives synthetic patient flow records for an emergency healthcare service, generated with discrete event simulation software (Simio, per the candidate title). The record read on 2026-09-28 lists nine small CSV files, each a few kilobytes, covering blood pressure checks, patient type classification, registration of new patients, medical records for four patient types, the outpatient department and triage, plus a README. Common fields include patient identifier and type, arrival and exit times, waiting time, the resource used and its utilisation, queue counts before and after each step, length of stay with and without queues, and a satisfaction score. The version is dated 3 December 2024. Coverage is a simulated facility, not a real hospital. Access is free under a CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. Caveats: the data are synthetic and small, the simulation assumptions are only in the README, which was not read, and results cannot stand in for observed hospital data. It supports capacity planning and emergency response studies, such as testing queue and staffing models for an emergency department during a surge. Related record: the Simio simulation platform.
